value: In the Stockades, Bazil Thredd describes the Stonemasons’ work as unpaid and cheated, then recounts the riot and VanCleef’s leadership. His account is evidence of what Bazil says, not a neutral verdict on every detail. The prison’s close stone and iron make the testimony feel contained, while the grievance reaches back to the rebuilt city.
editorNote: Attribute the grievance and riot narrative to Bazil. The quest transcription is secondary and awaits original-client comparison.
